entries.name: Cleave

description.from: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...40 damage. This attack also hits 1...2 random adjacent foes.
description.to: If this attack hits, you strike for +10...40 damage and hit 1...2 adjacent foe for 10...40 slashing damage.

concise.from: Deals +10...40 damage. Also hits 1...2 random adjacent foes.
concise.to: Deals +10...40 damage and hits 1...2 adjacent foe for 10...40 slashing damage.

notes: Follow-up to the 20260624 changeset's WIKI LAGGED override: the adjacent-hit clause was authored from patch notes before the wiki page updated. Wiki has since caught up and specifies the adjacent hits deal 10...40 slashing damage; text replaced with the wiki page's wording rendered to our style (fetchSkill, 2026-07-03).
